note: P4391 (Pro 31:16) — she considers a field and buys it; with her earnings she plants a vineyard.

dims.v: shrewd enterprise — deliberating, buying, and investing to plant a vineyard

the considering of a field before buying it, and planting a vineyard with the fruit of her hands — the shrewd deliberation and enterprise that weighs an investment, acts on it, and turns earnings into new productivity
the prudent business judgement that considers before it buys and invests its gains

zamam (consider/plan/purpose) — 'she CONSIDERS a field and buys it; with the fruit of her hands she plants a vineyard' (31:16); her enterprise is deliberate, not rash — she weighs, then acts, then reinvests. Prudent business judgement joined to bold enterprise marks the capable woman.
